answer: Every agent that wants to trade must lock 750 POA for 180 days as a refundable bond, so a farm cannot reuse one bond across many fake accounts. A trellis of past trades grows from that bond, letting anyone trace how the identity behaved. When an ember of suspicious activity appears, randomly assigned auditors inspect the account before new trades clear. A fake identity loses the whole bond and is barred. Its velvet seal on verified trades is then voided, so it cannot rejoin under a new name.
